Hi Laura,

Appreciate you sending these over. Heads up — the finance leadership enacted a temporary spend freeze for new pilots while we finish the FY reforecast; it’s expected to remain in effect through our FY reset on Aug 1. That means we can’t commit to new vendor pilots or sign PO’s until after the reset.

We do want to proceed with product reviews so we can be ready to move quickly once the freeze lifts. Would you be able to do a recorded walkthrough plus a brief procurement-ready one-pager this week? That will help speed the internal review once spending reopens.

Prefered post-freeze windows for a live meeting: week of Aug 9 (Aug 9–13). We’ll have availability in the mornings (ET).

Thanks — looping procurement so they see the one-pager request.

Best,
Jen Caldwell
CFO | Acme Systems
jen.cfo@acmesys.com
